name: Mechatronic
description: Builds a [color=#E92031]Redstone Monstrosity[/color], a walking war machine of stone and redstone. [color=#E92031]Monstrosity Mode[/color]: right click to summon it or use its Super Move, left click to give orders, Sneak + right click to recall it.

badge.name: Redstone Monstrosity
badge.description: Summons the [color=#E92031]Redstone Monstrosity[/color]. It draws the attention of enemies within 12 blocks and wears your armor. Left click orders it: a creature to attack, a block to hold, Sneak to follow. Running straight, it drops to all fours and gathers speed. Hold Jump in the air to rocket up, then glide. Broken down, it is rebuilt after 60s.

commons.name: Redstone Generator
commons.description: Its blows build up charge. Fully charged, it Overcharges: a roar raises a Cube Field around it that stops enemy projectiles, then for 6s it moves 50% faster, hits 50% harder and throws foes much further. Left alone, the charge drains away.

commons.name: Saddle
commons.description: Right click the Monstrosity to ride it. Left click: its lift. Right click: its Super Move. Hold Jump to charge a jump; while it gallops, a committed leap that lands with a slam. Press Jump again in the air to rocket. Sneak: get off.

adept.name: Piston Arm
adept.description: Super Move: both fists come down like pistons, 14 damage to everything within 4 blocks in front. Cooldown 6s.

adept.name: Dispenser Arm
adept.description: Super Move: its arms become cannons, one homing bolt each, 6 damage. Cooldown 5s.

master.name: Ministrosities
master.description: When it Overcharges, 3 Ministrosities scramble up out of the ground to fight beside it. They crumble when it goes.

master.name: Supercharged
master.description: Overcharged, it crackles with arcs: every blow it lands arcs on to up to 3 more enemies within 5 blocks, 5 damage each, and it takes 30% less damage.

grandmaster.name: Stride Servos
grandmaster.description: Its gallop is faster: 9.5 blocks/s (8 without). Double-tap forward while riding to gallop.

grandmaster.name: Rocket Boots
grandmaster.description: Its rockets burn longer and climb harder: 2.4s of thrust (1.6s without).
